title: Dose-Response Effects of a Brief Audio-Guided Mindfulness Intervention for Acute Pain
official: Dose-Response Effects of a Brief Audio-Guided Mindfulness Intervention for Acute Pain While Awaiting Orthopedic Care
summary: This project is a single-site, three-arm, randomized controlled trial investigating whether different length audio-recorded mindfulness practices differentially decrease pain among patients in a waiting room awaiting orthopedic care.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Receiving treatment at Tallahassee Orthopedic Center
* Understanding English instructions fluently
* Being 18 years of age or older

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to consent because of physical or mental incapacity.
